1.consolidated_definition: Pez de mar de gran belleza por sus colores azulosos, rosados, verdosos, lustrosos ya que el pez no tiene escamas. Tiene el pico largo y puntiagudo. Su aleta dorsal es amplia y con forma artística. Aunque su carne es de buena calidad, no es apreciable, pero se pesca deportivamente para disecarlo con propósito ornamental. Hay dos variedades, el azul y el blanco. También llamado pez aguja.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fish of the sea renowned for its striking azure, roseate, and verdant hues, as well as its glossy appearance, due to the absence of scales. It possesses a long, pointed snout and an expansive dorsal fin with an artistic shape. Although its flesh is of good quality, it is not considered palatable, but is nonetheless pursued recreationally for the purpose of being preserved as an ornamental specimen. Two varieties exist: blue and white. Also known as needlefish.
